scope: Earlier-scene recall test for the camera mamepa, added to the same lock hold after CAMERA-MAMEPA-PREREG.json (whose retention bar of 68.8% stays in force). The question can only be answered from a scene that ended before the current one and has left the stream's window. Code: branch claude/camera-mamepa, the commit named in SOURCE-COMMIT.txt.
registered_before_scoring: 2026-11-13, before any training, development check or fresh clip of this hold; the chain had not started

clips.earlier_scene: the Codex's moving-square generator, unchanged: seed 2026111503, 256 clips, speeds [14, 16], four 192x192 frames at 2 fps (stream times 0.0-1.5 s)
clips.current_scene: camera_mamepa_earlier.current_scene(1200000 + i): 16 frames (stream times 2.0-9.5 s) of one continuous synthetic scene: a fixed gradient background and one disc (no square) drifting 2-4 px per frame in a random direction independent of the label
clips.window_check: every clip's square frames must have left the window before the question (recorded per clip); a clip where any remain is reported and counted as scored anyway

question: Earlier in this video, before the current scene, a square moved across a plain background. In which direction did that square move? Answer with exactly one word: left, right, up, or down.

arms.no_recall: the same session asked with nothing added (the stream as it is)

arms.order: alternated by clip index parity; both answers rolled back; 8 tokens; temperature 0
arms.boundary: the development choice in mamepa-choice.json, unchanged

reported_not_gated: recall_found_earlier_scene rate (recalled segment starts at 0.0 with >= 2 frames)
